review.images: Original renders extracted from Aldar’s Ras Al Khaimah launch brochure. Includes the apartment buildings, pool, interiors and terrace. Excludes Rosso Bay and Meraas’s Pearl Jumeirah project.
review.location: Physical page 6 distinguishes Aldar’s two Al Marjan Island projects. Page 39 provides the single Dubai International Airport estimate. Excluded conflicting portal route estimates and unverified access coordinates.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed five complete official brochure sheets, five technical sheets in a public Madena-hosted document, and three differently shaped EZRE examples. The five-bedroom drawing marked 16-09 matches the public Lucretia unit table for AlMarjan-B2-16-09, which gives 6,021 sq ft. Source: https://www.lucretia-international.com/en/projects/aldar-nikki-beach-residences . The broker’s other unit drawings were available only as blurred previews. The Property Finder Type 1A repeats Aldar’s Type 1B geometry and furnishings, so was excluded. The Madena Type 1A is distinct and its label is retained.
